writeup: The NETGEAR C6250 (C6250-100NAS) is an AC1600 dual-band WiFi router with a built-in DOCSIS 3.0 cable modem, so it can replace a rented cable company box. Woot has it open box for $25.63, while ServersFit sells the same model refurbished for $96.15 and CompuDevices asks $166.26. Stock is very low with a limit of 2 per customer.
